import sys, zipfile, json, re
z=zipfile.ZipFile(sys.argv[1])
n=0
for name in sorted(z.namelist()):
    r=json.loads(z.read(name))
    if 'withdrawn' in r: continue
    for a in r.get('affected',[]):
        p=a.get('package',{})
        if p.get('ecosystem')=='PyPI':
            raw=p['name']
            if raw!=re.sub(r'[-_.]+','-',raw).lower():
                n+=1
                if n<=12: print(r['id'],raw,len(r['affected']),'versions',len(a.get('versions') or []),[x.get('type') for x in a.get('ranges',[])])
print(n)
